title: PUNCHY HITS ON CONFIRM AND ON THE SCORE COUNT
why: His answer Q48: menus get soft ticks, punchy hits on confirm and score. The confirm click had no weight and the score count-ups on the run over card and the career end card were silent. A press now has a short low thump under the click, a counting score plays a hit a step (one every 70 ms, pitch climbing) and one heavier landing hit, and a skip plays only the landing. Sound only.
now: A press lands with a thump, and a score counts up with hits and lands with a heavier one.
